import itertools
import time

def is_costas(perm):
    n = len(perm)
    diffs = set()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            dr = perm[j] - perm[i]
            dc = j - i
            if (dr, dc) in diffs:
                return False
            diffs.add((dr, dc))
    return True
